notes: Printed Griffin Aerie: 'At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, create a 2/2 white Griffin creature token with flying.' Turn 1: gain 2 (Radiant Fountain), end step -> no token (2 < 3). Turn 3: gain 1 (Bloodfell Caves); 3 gained across turns but only 1 this turn -> no token. Turn 5: gain 2 + 1 = exactly 3 this turn -> one 2/2 flying Griffin. Life 20+2+1+2+1 = 26. Opponent end steps (turns 2, 4) make nothing.
